65	class ServiceError(Exception):
66	    """A validation/lookup failure carrying an HTTP status and a field name."""
67	
68	    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str = "", status_code: int = 400) -> None:
69	        super().__init__(message)
70	        self.message = message
71	        self.field = field
72	        self.status_code = status_code
73	
74	    def to_body(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
75	        """JSON-serializable error body naming the offending field."""
76	        body: Dict[str, Any] = {"message": self.message}
77	        if self.field:
78	            body["field"] = self.field
79	        return body
80	
81	
82	class DeviceService:
83	    """Validates payloads and coordinates the :class:`DeviceStore`."""
84	
85	    def __init__(self, store: Optional[DeviceStore] = None) -> None:
86	        self.store = store if store is not None else DeviceStore()
87	
88	    # -- registration ------------------------------------------------------
89	
90	    def register(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
91	        """Validate and persist a registration payload; return the 201 body."""
92	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
93	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object", "request_body")
94	
95	        for name in _REQUIRED_SCALAR_FIELDS:
96	            if name not in payload:
97	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
98	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
99	                raise ServiceError(f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
100	
101	        if "signed_prekeys" not in payload:
102	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: signed_prekeys",
103	                               "signed_prekeys")
104	        raw_prekeys = payload["signed_prekeys"]
105	        if not isinstance(raw_prekeys, list):
106	            raise ServiceError("field must be an array: signed_prekeys",
107	                               "signed_prekeys")
108	
109	        prekeys: List[SignedPreKey] = []
110	        seen_key_ids: set = set()
111	        for index, element in enumerate(raw_prekeys):
112	            prefix = f"signed_prekeys[{index}]"
113	            if not isinstance(element, dict):
114	                raise ServiceError(f"array element must be an object: {prefix}", prefix)
115	            for subfield in ("key_id", "public_key"):
116	                path = f"{prefix}.{subfield}"
117	                if subfield not in element:
118	                    raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {path}", path)
119	                if not is_nonempty_string(element[subfield]):
120	                    raise ServiceError(
121	                        f"field must be a non-empty string: {path}", path)
122	            if element["key_id"] in seen_key_ids:
123	                raise ServiceError(
124	                    f"duplicate key_id in signed_prekeys: {element['key_id']}",
125	                    f"{prefix}.key_id")
126	            if load_public_key(element["public_key"]) is None:
127	                raise ServiceError(
128	                    f"field is not a valid public key: {prefix}.public_key",
129	                    f"{prefix}.public_key")
130	            seen_key_ids.add(element["key_id"])
131	            prekeys.append(SignedPreKey(element["key_id"], element["public_key"]))
132	
133	        if load_public_key(payload["identity_key"]) is None:
134	            raise ServiceError("field is not a valid public key: identity_key",
135	                               "identity_key")
136	
137	        device = Device(
138	            user_id=payload["user_id"],
139	            device_id=payload["device_id"],
140	            identity_key=payload["identity_key"],
141	            prekeys=prekeys,
142	        )
143	        if not self.store.add_device(device):
144	            raise ServiceError(
145	                f"device_id already registered: {device.device_id}",
146	                "device_id", status_code=409)
147	
148	        return {"device_id": device.device_id,
149	                "registered_at": device.registered_at}
150	
151	    # -- lookup ------------------------------------------------------------
152	
153	    def get_device(self, device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
154	        """Return the public device record; raise :class:`ServiceError` if absent."""
155	        view = self.store.public_view(device_id)
156	        if view is None:
157	            raise ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
158	                               "device_id", status_code=404)
159	        return view
160	
161	    # -- revocation --------------------------------------------------------
162	
163	    def revoke_device(self, device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
164	        """Revoke a device (and its pre-keys); idempotent, 404 when unknown."""
165	        device = self.store.revoke_device(device_id)
166	        if device is None:
167	            raise ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
168	                               "device_id", status_code=404)
169	        return {"device_id": device.device_id, "revoked": True}
170	
171	    def revoke_prekey(self, device_id: str, key_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
172	        """Revoke one pre-key; idempotent, 404 on unknown device/key."""
173	        device, key_found = self.store.revoke_prekey_by_id(device_id, key_id)
174	        if device is None:
175	            raise ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
176	                               "device_id", status_code=404)
177	        if not key_found:
178	            raise ServiceError(f"pre-key not found: {key_id}",
179	                               "key_id", status_code=404)
180	        return {"device_id": device.device_id, "key_id": key_id, "revoked": True}
181	
182	    # -- identity rotation & pre-key replenishment -------------------------
183	
184	    def rotate_identity_key(self, device_id: str,
185	                            payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
186	        """Validate and apply an identity-key rotation.
187	
188	        The new ``identity_key`` must be a non-empty, valid public key. The
189	        same value as the current key is a no-op that leaves ``rotated_at``
190	        unchanged; a changed value stamps a fresh UTC ISO-8601 ``rotated_at``.
191	        Unknown device is 404, revoked device is 409 (both field
192	        ``device_id``); nothing is written on failure.
193	        """
194	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
195	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
196	                               "request_body")
197	        if "identity_key" not in payload:
198	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: identity_key",
199	                               "identity_key")
200	        if not is_nonempty_string(payload["identity_key"]):
201	            raise ServiceError(
202	                "field must be a non-empty string: identity_key",
203	                "identity_key")
204	        if load_public_key(payload["identity_key"]) is None:
205	            raise ServiceError(
206	                "field is not a valid public key: identity_key",
207	                "identity_key")
208	
209	        try:
210	            view, _changed = self.store.rotate_identity_key(
211	                device_id, payload["identity_key"])
212	        except DeviceUpdateError as error:
213	            raise self._device_update_error(error, device_id)
214	        return view
215	
216	    def add_prekey(self, device_id: str,
217	                   payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
218	        """Validate and append a pre-key, or confirm an identical existing one.
219	
220	        ``key_id`` and ``public_key`` must be non-empty strings and the key
221	        must parse as a public key. A new id appends in order (201); an
222	        existing id with the same, non-revoked key is idempotent (200); a
223	        changed key or a revoked id conflicts (409/key_id). Unknown device is
224	        404, revoked device 409 (field ``device_id``). Returns
225	        ``(body, status_code)``.
226	        """
227	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
228	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
229	                               "request_body")
230	        for name in ("key_id", "public_key"):
231	            if name not in payload:
232	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
233	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
234	                raise ServiceError(
235	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
236	        if load_public_key(payload["public_key"]) is None:
237	            raise ServiceError(
238	                "field is not a valid public key: public_key", "public_key")
239	
240	        try:
241	            view, created = self.store.add_prekey(
242	                device_id, payload["key_id"], payload["public_key"])
243	        except DeviceUpdateError as error:
244	            raise self._device_update_error(error, device_id)
245	        return view, 201 if created else 200
246	
247	    @staticmethod
248	    def _device_update_error(error: DeviceUpdateError,
249	                             device_id: str) -> ServiceError:
250	        """Translate a rotation/add-pre-key storage failure to a ServiceError."""
251	        if error.reason == DEVICE_UNKNOWN:
252	            return ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
253	                                "device_id", status_code=404)
254	        if error.reason == DEVICE_REVOKED:
255	            return ServiceError("device_id is revoked",
256	                                "device_id", status_code=409)
257	        if error.reason == PREKEY_CONFLICT:
258	            return ServiceError(
259	                "key_id already exists with a different key or is revoked",
260	                "key_id", status_code=409)
261	        raise  # pragma: no cover - defensive
262	
263	    # -- sessions ----------------------------------------------------------
264	
265	    def create_session(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
266	        """Validate a session-negotiation payload and atomically create it.
267	
268	        Every request creates a fresh session (a new ``session_id``); repeated
269	        POSTs are never deduplicated.
270	        """
271	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
272	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
273	                               "request_body")
274	
275	        for name in _SESSION_SCALAR_FIELDS:
276	            if name not in payload:
277	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
278	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
279	                raise ServiceError(
280	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
281	
282	        if load_public_key(payload["ephemeral_key"]) is None:
283	            raise ServiceError(
284	                "field is not a valid public key: ephemeral_key",
285	                "ephemeral_key")
286	
287	        if payload["initiator_device_id"] == payload["recipient_device_id"]:
288	            raise ServiceError(
289	                "recipient_device_id must differ from initiator_device_id",
290	                "recipient_device_id")
291	
292	        try:
293	            session = self.store.create_session(
294	                payload["initiator_device_id"],
295	                payload["recipient_device_id"],
296	                payload["prekey_id"],
297	                payload["ephemeral_key"])
298	        except SessionCreateError as error:
299	            status_code, field = _SESSION_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
300	            if status_code == 404:
301	                if field == "prekey_id":
302	                    message = f"pre-key not found: {payload['prekey_id']}"
303	                else:
304	                    device_id = payload[field]
305	                    message = f"device not found: {device_id}"
306	            else:
307	                message = f"{field} is revoked"
308	            raise ServiceError(message, field, status_code=status_code)
309	
310	        return self.store.session_view(session.session_id)  # type: ignore[return-value]
311	
312	    def get_session(self, session_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
313	        """Return the immutable eight-field session snapshot; 404 if unknown."""
314	        view = self.store.session_view(session_id)
315	        if view is None:
316	            raise ServiceError(f"session not found: {session_id}",
317	                               "session_id", status_code=404)
318	        return view
319	
320	    # -- messages ----------------------------------------------------------
321	
322	    def post_message(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
323	        """Validate a message-send payload and atomically append the message.
324	
325	        ``sequence`` must continue the session's stream (starting at 1, no
326	        gaps or duplicates) and ``message_id`` must be unique within the
327	        session; violations are 409s, as is a revoked/unknown sender device.
328	        """
329	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
330	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
331	                               "request_body")
332	
333	        for name in _MESSAGE_STRING_FIELDS:
334	            if name not in payload:
335	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
336	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
337	                raise ServiceError(
338	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
339	
340	        if "sequence" not in payload:
341	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: sequence", "sequence")
342	        sequence = payload["sequence"]
343	        # bool is a subclass of int; reject it explicitly.
344	        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
345	            raise ServiceError("field must be an integer: sequence", "sequence")
346	
347	        try:
348	            message = self.store.append_message(
349	                payload["session_id"],
350	                payload["sender_device_id"],
351	                payload["message_id"],
352	                sequence,
353	                payload["nonce"],
354	                payload["ciphertext"])
355	        except MessageCreateError as error:
356	            status_code, field = _MESSAGE_CREATE_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
357	            if error.reason == MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
358	                message_text = f"session not found: {payload['session_id']}"
359	            elif error.reason == MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE:
360	                message_text = "sender_device_id is not an active device"
361	            elif error.reason == MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID:
362	                message_text = (f"message_id already exists in session: "
363	                                f"{payload['message_id']}")
364	            else:
365	                message_text = (f"sequence must continue the session stream "
366	                                f"(got {sequence})")
367	            raise ServiceError(message_text, field, status_code=status_code)
368	
369	        return self.store.message_view(message)
370	
371	    def list_messages(self, session_id: str, device_id: str, after: int,
372	                      limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
373	        """Return one page of a session's messages plus the resume cursor."""
374	        try:
375	            messages, next_after = self.store.message_page(
376	                session_id, device_id, after, limit)
377	        except MessageListError as error:
378	            if error.reason == MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
379	                raise ServiceError(f"session not found: {session_id}",
380	                                   "session_id", status_code=404)
381	            if error.reason == MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE:
382	                raise ServiceError("device_id is not an active device",
383	                                   "device_id", status_code=409)
384	            raise  # pragma: no cover - defensive
385	        return {"messages": messages, "next_after": next_after}
386	
387	    # -- reliable delivery -------------------------------------------------
388	
389	    #: Maps a delivery failure reason to (HTTP status, field name).
390	    _DELIVERY_ERROR_MAP = {
391	        DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN: (404, "session_id"),
392	        DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN: (404, "message_id"),
393	        DELIVERY_DEVICE_INACTIVE: (409, "device_id"),
394	        DELIVERY_DEVICE_MISMATCH: (409, "device_id"),
395	        DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE: (409, "sequence"),
396	    }
397	
398	    def _delivery_error(self, error: DeliveryError,
399	                        session_id: str, message_id: str,
400	                        sequence: Optional[int] = None) -> ServiceError:
401	        """Translate a storage :class:`DeliveryError` into a ServiceError."""
402	        status_code, field = self._DELIVERY_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
403	        if error.reason == DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
404	            text = f"session not found: {session_id}"
405	        elif error.reason == DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN:
406	            text = f"message not found: {message_id}"
407	        elif error.reason == DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE:
408	            text = f"sequence does not match the message (got {sequence})"
409	        else:
410	            text = "device_id is not the active recipient of this session"
411	        return ServiceError(text, field, status_code=status_code)
412	
413	    def retry_message(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
414	                      payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
415	        """Validate and record one delivery attempt for a message.
416	
417	        Returns ``(body, 201)`` for the first attempt and ``(body, 200)`` for
418	        a repeated attempt. A repeated ``attempt_id`` is not counted again;
419	        retries after an ack still succeed with status ``acked``.
420	        """
421	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
422	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
423	                               "request_body")
424	        for name in ("device_id", "attempt_id"):
425	            if name not in payload:
426	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
427	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
428	                raise ServiceError(
429	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
430	
431	        try:
432	            view, created = self.store.retry_message(
433	                session_id, message_id,
434	                payload["device_id"], payload["attempt_id"])
435	        except DeliveryError as error:
436	            raise self._delivery_error(error, session_id, message_id)
437	        return view, 201 if created else 200
438	
439	    def ack_message(self, session_id: str, payload: object
440	                    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
441	        """Validate and record an acknowledgement.
442	
443	        The session is taken from the URL; the body carries ``device_id``,
444	        ``message_id`` and the integer ``sequence``. The first ack returns 201
445	        and marks the message acked; repeated acks return 200 and leave the
446	        acked state in place.
447	        """
448	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
449	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
450	                               "request_body")
451	        for name in ("device_id", "message_id"):
452	            if name not in payload:
453	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
454	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
455	                raise ServiceError(
456	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
457	        if "sequence" not in payload:
458	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: sequence", "sequence")
459	        sequence = payload["sequence"]
460	        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
461	            raise ServiceError("field must be an integer: sequence", "sequence")
462	
463	        try:
464	            view, first_ack = self.store.ack_message(
465	                session_id, payload["message_id"],
466	                payload["device_id"], sequence)
467	        except DeliveryError as error:
468	            raise self._delivery_error(
469	                error, session_id, payload["message_id"], sequence)
470	        return view, 201 if first_ack else 200
471	
472	    def message_status(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
473	                       device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
474	        """Return one message's delivery status for its active recipient."""
475	        try:
476	            return self.store.message_delivery_status(
477	                session_id, message_id, device_id)
478	        except DeliveryError as error:
479	            raise self._delivery_error(error, session_id, message_id)

1	"""Thread-safe in-memory device storage.
2	
3	Devices live for the lifetime of the server process. Only public keys and
4	identifiers are retained. Reads return pre-key ids in the exact insertion
5	order, so repeated requests list them identically.
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import threading
10	import uuid
11	from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
12	
13	from .models import Device, Message, MessageDelivery, Session, SignedPreKey, utc_now_iso
14	
15	#: Outcome codes for a failed atomic session creation.
16	SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN = "initiator_unknown"
17	SESSION_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN = "recipient_unknown"
18	SESSION_PREKEY_UNKNOWN = "prekey_unknown"
19	SESSION_INITIATOR_REVOKED = "initiator_revoked"
20	SESSION_RECIPIENT_REVOKED = "recipient_revoked"
21	SESSION_PREKEY_REVOKED = "prekey_revoked"
22	
23	#: Outcome codes for a failed atomic message append.
24	MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN = "session_unknown"
25	MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE = "sender_inactive"
26	MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID = "duplicate_message_id"
27	MESSAGE_BAD_SEQUENCE = "bad_sequence"
28	
29	#: Outcome code for a failed message listing.
30	MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE = "device_inactive"
31	
32	#: Outcome codes for delivery (retry/ack/status) failures.
33	DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN = "session_unknown"
34	DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN = "message_unknown"
35	DELIVERY_DEVICE_MISMATCH = "device_mismatch"
36	DELIVERY_DEVICE_INACTIVE = "device_inactive"
37	DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE = "bad_sequence"
38	
39	#: Outcome codes for identity-key rotation.
40	DEVICE_UNKNOWN = "device_unknown"
41	DEVICE_REVOKED = "device_revoked"
42	#: Outcome code for a pre-key add conflict (same id, changed key, or revoked).
43	PREKEY_CONFLICT = "prekey_conflict"
44	
45	
46	class SessionCreateError(Exception):
47	    """An atomic session lookup/revocation check failed (nothing was written)."""
48	
49	    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
50	        super().__init__(reason)
51	        self.reason = reason
52	
53	
54	class MessageCreateError(Exception):
55	    """An atomic message append check failed (nothing was written)."""
56	
57	    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
58	        super().__init__(reason)
59	        self.reason = reason
60	
61	
62	class MessageListError(Exception):
63	    """An atomic message listing check failed."""
64	
65	    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
66	        super().__init__(reason)
67	        self.reason = reason
68	
69	
70	class DeliveryError(Exception):
71	    """An atomic delivery (retry/ack/status) check failed; nothing changed."""
72	
73	    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
74	        super().__init__(reason)
75	        self.reason = reason
76	
77	
78	class DeviceUpdateError(Exception):
79	    """An atomic identity-key rotation or pre-key add failed; nothing changed."""
80	
81	    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
82	        super().__init__(reason)
83	        self.reason = reason
84	
85	
86	class DeviceStore:
87	    """In-memory store keyed by ``(user_id, device_id)``.
88	
89	    Device ids are additionally indexed globally, because the public GET route
90	    addresses a device by ``device_id`` alone.
91	    """
92	
93	    def __init__(self) -> None:
94	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
95	        self._devices: Dict[Tuple[str, str], Device] = {}
96	        self._device_index: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]] = {}
97	        self._sessions: Dict[str, Session] = {}
98	        self._messages: Dict[str, List[Message]] = {}
99	        # Delivery state keyed by (session_id, message_id).
100	        self._delivery: Dict[Tuple[str, str], MessageDelivery] = {}
101	        # Called (under the lock) after any state mutation, for persistence.
102	        self.on_change: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None
103	
104	    def _notify_change(self) -> None:
105	        """Invoke the persistence hook after a committed mutation."""
106	        if self.on_change is not None:
107	            self.on_change()
108	
109	    def add_device(self, device: Device) -> bool:
110	        """Insert a device.
111	
112	        Return ``False`` (and store nothing) when the same ``device_id`` is
113	        already registered, whether under the same user or another one.
114	        """
115	        key = (device.user_id, device.device_id)
116	        with self._lock:
117	            if key in self._devices or device.device_id in self._device_index:
118	                return False
119	            self._devices[key] = device
120	            self._device_index[device.device_id] = key
121	            self._notify_change()
122	            return True
123	
124	    def get_device(self, user_id: str, device_id: str) -> Optional[Device]:
125	        """Return the device for the user, or ``None``."""
126	        with self._lock:
127	            return self._devices.get((user_id, device_id))
128	
129	    def find_by_device_id(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Device]:
130	        """Return the (globally unique) device with this id, or ``None``."""
131	        with self._lock:
132	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
133	            return self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
134	
135	    def active_prekey_ids(self, device: Device) -> List[str]:
136	        """Return key ids of non-revoked pre-keys, in stable insertion order."""
137	        with self._lock:
138	            return [pk.key_id for pk in device.prekeys if not pk.revoked]
139	
140	    def revoke_prekey(self, device: Device, key_id: str) -> bool:
141	        """Mark one of the device's pre-keys revoked. Return ``False`` if absent."""
142	        with self._lock:
143	            for prekey in device.prekeys:
144	                if prekey.key_id == key_id:
145	                    prekey.revoked = True
146	                    self._notify_change()
147	                    return True
148	            return False
149	
150	    def revoke_device(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Device]:
151	        """Mark the device (and its pre-keys) revoked.
152	
153	        Idempotent: a previously revoked device stays revoked. Returns the
154	        device or ``None`` when the id is unknown.
155	        """
156	        with self._lock:
157	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
158	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
159	            if device is None:
160	                return None
161	            device.revoked = True
162	            for prekey in device.prekeys:
163	                prekey.revoked = True
164	            self._notify_change()
165	            return device
166	
167	    def revoke_prekey_by_id(self, device_id: str,
168	                            key_id: str) -> Tuple[Optional[Device], bool]:
169	        """Revoke one pre-key of a globally-addressed device.
170	
171	        Returns ``(device, key_found)``: ``device`` is ``None`` for an unknown
172	        device; otherwise ``key_found`` says whether *key_id* existed. Revoking
173	        an already-revoked key is idempotent and reports it as found.
174	        """
175	        with self._lock:
176	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
177	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
178	            if device is None:
179	                return None, False
180	            for prekey in device.prekeys:
181	                if prekey.key_id == key_id:
182	                    prekey.revoked = True
183	                    self._notify_change()
184	                    return device, True
185	            return device, False
186	
187	    def identity_view(self, device: Device) -> Dict[str, Any]:
188	        """Copy the device's current identity material into a three-field view."""
189	        return {
190	            "device_id": device.device_id,
191	            "identity_key": device.identity_key,
192	            "rotated_at": device.rotated_at,
193	        }
194	
195	    def rotate_identity_key(self, device_id: str, identity_key: str
196	                            ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
197	        """Atomically rotate a device's identity key.
198	
199	        Returns ``(view, changed)``: ``changed`` is True when the key was
200	        actually replaced (and ``rotated_at`` advanced), False when the new
201	        key equals the stored one (idempotent; ``rotated_at`` untouched).
202	        Unknown -> :class:`DeviceUpdateError` ``device_unknown`` (404);
203	        revoked -> ``device_revoked`` (409). All checks and the write happen
204	        under the store lock; a failure writes nothing.
205	        """
206	        with self._lock:
207	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
208	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
209	            if device is None:
210	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
211	            if device.revoked:
212	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_REVOKED)
213	            changed = identity_key != device.identity_key
214	            if changed:
215	                device.identity_key = identity_key
216	                device.rotated_at = utc_now_iso()
217	                self._notify_change()
218	            return self.identity_view(device), changed
219	
220	    def add_prekey(self, device_id: str, key_id: str, public_key: str
221	                   ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
222	        """Atomically append a pre-key (or confirm an identical existing one).
223	
224	        A new ``key_id`` is appended in order and reported with ``created``
225	        True (201). An existing, non-revoked key with the same ``public_key``
226	        is idempotent (200, ``created`` False). An existing id with a changed
227	        key, or an id whose key was revoked, raises
228	        :class:`DeviceUpdateError` ``prekey_conflict`` (409/key_id). Unknown
229	        device -> ``device_unknown`` (404), revoked device -> ``device_revoked``
230	        (409). Locked; a failure writes nothing.
231	        """
232	        with self._lock:
233	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
234	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
235	            if device is None:
236	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
237	            if device.revoked:
238	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_REVOKED)
239	            existing = next((pk for pk in device.prekeys
240	                             if pk.key_id == key_id), None)
241	            if existing is not None:
242	                if not existing.revoked and existing.public_key == public_key:
243	                    return ({"device_id": device.device_id,
244	                             "key_id": existing.key_id,
245	                             "public_key": existing.public_key}, False)
246	                raise DeviceUpdateError(PREKEY_CONFLICT)
247	            prekey = SignedPreKey(key_id=key_id, public_key=public_key)
248	            device.prekeys.append(prekey)
249	            self._notify_change()
250	            return ({"device_id": device.device_id,
251	                     "key_id": prekey.key_id,
252	                     "public_key": prekey.public_key}, True)
253	
254	    def public_view(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
255	        """Atomically build the public snapshot of a device.
256	
257	        The active pre-key id list is copied under the lock together with the
258	        rest of the record, so a concurrent revocation can never be observed
259	        half-applied.
260	        """
261	        with self._lock:
262	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
263	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
264	            if device is None:
265	                return None
266	            return {
267	                "identity_key": device.identity_key,
268	                "prekey_ids": [pk.key_id for pk in device.prekeys
269	                               if not pk.revoked],
270	                "registered_at": device.registered_at,
271	            }
272	
273	    # -- sessions ----------------------------------------------------------
274	
275	    def create_session(self, initiator_device_id: str, recipient_device_id: str,
276	                       prekey_id: str, ephemeral_key: str) -> Session:
277	        """Atomically validate and create one session.
278	
279	        Lookups, revocation checks and the insert all happen while holding the
280	        store lock (the same lock device/pre-key revocations take), so a
281	        concurrent revocation is linearized either wholly before this call
282	        (then it fails) or wholly after it (then the session is retained).
283	        On any failure nothing is written and :class:`SessionCreateError`
284	        carries the reason.
285	        """
286	        with self._lock:
287	            initiator = self._device_index.get(initiator_device_id)
288	            initiator = self._devices.get(initiator) if initiator is not None else None
289	            if initiator is None:
290	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN)
291	            if initiator.revoked:
292	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_INITIATOR_REVOKED)
293	
294	            recipient_key = self._device_index.get(recipient_device_id)
295	            recipient = (self._devices.get(recipient_key)
296	                         if recipient_key is not None else None)
297	            if recipient is None:
298	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN)
299	            if recipient.revoked:
300	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_RECIPIENT_REVOKED)
301	
302	            used_prekey = next((pk for pk in recipient.prekeys
303	                                if pk.key_id == prekey_id), None)
304	            if used_prekey is None:
305	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_PREKEY_UNKNOWN)
306	            if used_prekey.revoked:
307	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_PREKEY_REVOKED)
308	
309	            session = Session(
310	                session_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
311	                initiator_device_id=initiator_device_id,
312	                recipient_device_id=recipient_device_id,
313	                prekey_id=prekey_id,
314	                ephemeral_key=ephemeral_key,
315	                identity_key=recipient.identity_key,
316	                public_key=used_prekey.public_key,
317	            )
318	            self._sessions[session.session_id] = session
319	            self._notify_change()
320	            return session
321	
322	    def session_view(self, session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
323	        """Return the immutable eight-field snapshot of a session, or ``None``.
324	
325	        The values are copied under the lock; session records are never
326	        mutated after creation, so revocations cannot change this view.
327	        """
328	        with self._lock:
329	            session = self._sessions.get(session_id)
330	            if session is None:
331	                return None
332	            return {
333	                "session_id": session.session_id,
334	                "initiator_device_id": session.initiator_device_id,
335	                "recipient_device_id": session.recipient_device_id,
336	                "prekey_id": session.prekey_id,
337	                "ephemeral_key": session.ephemeral_key,
338	                "identity_key": session.identity_key,
339	                "public_key": session.public_key,
340	                "created_at": session.created_at,
341	            }
342	
343	    # -- messages ----------------------------------------------------------
344	
345	    @staticmethod
346	    def message_view(message: Message) -> Dict[str, Any]:
347	        """Copy one message envelope into its public seven-field view."""
348	        return {
349	            "session_id": message.session_id,
350	            "sender_device_id": message.sender_device_id,
351	            "message_id": message.message_id,
352	            "sequence": message.sequence,
353	            "nonce": message.nonce,
354	            "ciphertext": message.ciphertext,
355	            "created_at": message.created_at,
356	        }
357	
358	    def append_message(self, session_id: str, sender_device_id: str,
359	                       message_id: str, sequence: int, nonce: str,
360	                       ciphertext: str) -> Message:
361	        """Atomically validate and append one message to a session's stream.
362	
363	        The session lookup, sender revocation check, duplicate-id check and
364	        sequence-continuity check all happen while holding the store lock (the
365	        same lock device revocations take), so a concurrent revocation is
366	        linearized either wholly before this call (then it fails) or wholly
367	        after it (then the message is retained). On any failure nothing is
368	        written and :class:`MessageCreateError` carries the reason.
369	        """
370	        with self._lock:
371	            if session_id not in self._sessions:
372	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN)
373	
374	            sender_key = self._device_index.get(sender_device_id)
375	            sender = (self._devices.get(sender_key)
376	                      if sender_key is not None else None)
377	            if sender is None or sender.revoked:
378	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE)
379	
380	            stream = self._messages.setdefault(session_id, [])
381	            if any(m.message_id == message_id for m in stream):
382	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID)
383	            expected = stream[-1].sequence + 1 if stream else 1
384	            if sequence != expected:
385	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_BAD_SEQUENCE)
386	
387	            message = Message(
388	                session_id=session_id,
389	                sender_device_id=sender_device_id,
390	                message_id=message_id,
391	                sequence=sequence,
392	                nonce=nonce,
393	                ciphertext=ciphertext,
394	            )
395	            stream.append(message)
396	            self._notify_change()
397	            return message
398	
399	    def message_page(self, session_id: str, device_id: str, after: int,
400	                     limit: int) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], int]:
401	        """Atomically read one ascending page of a session's messages.
402	
403	        Returns ``(message_views, next_after)``: the envelopes with
404	        ``sequence > after`` (ascending, at most *limit*) and the sequence to
405	        resume from — the last returned sequence, or *after* itself when the
406	        page is empty. The session lookup and the reader's revocation check
407	        run under the store lock, so a concurrent revocation is linearized
408	        either wholly before (then it fails) or wholly after this call.
409	        """
410	        with self._lock:
411	            if session_id not in self._sessions:
412	                raise MessageListError(MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN)
413	
414	            device_key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
415	            device = (self._devices.get(device_key)
416	                      if device_key is not None else None)
417	            if device is None or device.revoked:
418	                raise MessageListError(MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE)
419	
420	            stream = self._messages.get(session_id, [])
421	            page = [m for m in stream if m.sequence > after][:limit]
422	            next_after = page[-1].sequence if page else after
423	            return [self.message_view(m) for m in page], next_after
424	
425	    # -- delivery (reliable retry/ack/status) ------------------------------
426	
427	    @staticmethod
428	    def _delivery_view(session_id: str, message: Message,
429	                       state: Optional["MessageDelivery"]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
430	        """Build the five-field delivery status view of one message."""
431	        return {
432	            "session_id": session_id,
433	            "message_id": message.message_id,
434	            "status": "acked" if state is not None and state.acked
435	            else "pending",
436	            "attempts": state.attempts if state is not None else 0,
437	            "sequence": message.sequence,
438	        }
439	
440	    def _delivery_target(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
441	                         device_id: str
442	                         ) -> Tuple[Session, Message]:
443	        """Resolve and authorize a (session, message, recipient) triple.
444	
445	        Must be called while holding the store lock. Raises
446	        :class:`DeliveryError` with the mapped reason on any failure.
447	        """
448	        session = self._sessions.get(session_id)
449	        if session is None:
450	            raise DeliveryError(DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN)
451	        message = next((m for m in self._messages.get(session_id, [])
452	                        if m.message_id == message_id), None)
453	        if message is None:
454	            raise DeliveryError(DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN)
455	        device_key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
456	        device = (self._devices.get(device_key)
457	                  if device_key is not None else None)
458	        if device is None or device.revoked:
459	            raise DeliveryError(DELIVERY_DEVICE_INACTIVE)
460	        if device_id != session.recipient_device_id:
461	            raise DeliveryError(DELIVERY_DEVICE_MISMATCH)
462	        return session, message
463	
464	    def retry_message(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
465	                      device_id: str, attempt_id: str
466	                      ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
467	        """Atomically record one delivery attempt for a message.
468	
469	        The recipient must be the session's active recipient. Each distinct
470	        ``attempt_id`` is counted exactly once, so retries with the same id
471	        are idempotent. Returns ``(view, created)`` where ``created`` says
472	        whether this is the first ever attempt for the message (201 vs 200).
473	        Nothing changes on a failed authorization check.
474	        """
475	        with self._lock:
476	            _, message = self._delivery_target(
477	                session_id, message_id, device_id)
478	            key = (session_id, message_id)
479	            state = self._delivery.get(key)
480	            created = state is None
481	            if created:
482	                state = MessageDelivery()
483	                self._delivery[key] = state
484	            if attempt_id not in state.attempt_ids:
485	                state.attempt_ids.add(attempt_id)
486	                state.attempts += 1
487	            view = self._delivery_view(session_id, message, state)
488	            self._notify_change()
489	            return view, created
490	
491	    def ack_message(self, session_id: str, message_id: str, device_id: str,
492	                    sequence: int) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
493	        """Atomically acknowledge a message for the active recipient.
494	
495	        ``sequence`` must equal the message's stored sequence. The first ack
496	        marks the message acked; repeated acks are idempotent. Returns
497	        ``(view, first_ack)``.
498	        """
499	        with self._lock:
500	            _, message = self._delivery_target(
501	                session_id, message_id, device_id)
502	            if sequence != message.sequence:
503	                raise DeliveryError(DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE)
504	            key = (session_id, message_id)
505	            state = self._delivery.get(key)
506	            first_ack = state is None or not state.acked
507	            if state is None:
508	                state = MessageDelivery()
509	                self._delivery[key] = state
510	            state.acked = True
511	            state.ack_sequence = sequence
512	            view = self._delivery_view(session_id, message, state)
513	            self._notify_change()
514	            return view, first_ack
515	
516	    def message_delivery_status(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
517	                                device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
518	        """Atomically read one message's delivery status for its recipient."""
519	        with self._lock:
520	            _, message = self._delivery_target(
521	                session_id, message_id, device_id)
522	            state = self._delivery.get((session_id, message_id))
523	            return self._delivery_view(session_id, message, state)
524	
525	    # -- persistence snapshot ----------------------------------------------
526	
527	    def snapshot_state(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
528	        """Return a JSON-serializable deep copy of all stored state.
529	
530	        Copied under the store lock, so the snapshot is a consistent
531	        linearization point: concurrent mutations are never seen half-applied.
532	        """
533	        with self._lock:
534	            devices = []
535	            for (user_id, _device_id), device in self._devices.items():
536	                devices.append({
537	                    "user_id": device.user_id,
538	                    "device_id": device.device_id,
539	                    "identity_key": device.identity_key,
540	                    "registered_at": device.registered_at,
541	                    "rotated_at": device.rotated_at,
542	                    "revoked": device.revoked,
543	                    "prekeys": [{"key_id": pk.key_id,
544	                                 "public_key": pk.public_key,
545	                                 "revoked": pk.revoked}
546	                                for pk in device.prekeys],
547	                })
548	            sessions = [{
549	                "session_id": s.session_id,
550	                "initiator_device_id": s.initiator_device_id,
551	                "recipient_device_id": s.recipient_device_id,
552	                "prekey_id": s.prekey_id,
553	                "ephemeral_key": s.ephemeral_key,
554	                "identity_key": s.identity_key,
555	                "public_key": s.public_key,
556	                "created_at": s.created_at,
557	            } for s in self._sessions.values()]
558	            messages = {
559	                sid: [{
560	                    "session_id": m.session_id,
561	                    "sender_device_id": m.sender_device_id,
562	                    "message_id": m.message_id,
563	                    "sequence": m.sequence,
564	                    "nonce": m.nonce,
565	                    "ciphertext": m.ciphertext,
566	                    "created_at": m.created_at,
567	                } for m in stream]
568	                for sid, stream in self._messages.items()
569	            }
570	            delivery = [{
571	                "session_id": sid,
572	                "message_id": mid,
573	                "attempts": state.attempts,
574	                "attempt_ids": sorted(state.attempt_ids),
575	                "acked": state.acked,
576	                "ack_sequence": state.ack_sequence,
577	            } for (sid, mid), state in self._delivery.items()]
578	            return {"devices": devices, "sessions": sessions,
579	                    "messages": messages, "delivery": delivery}
580	
581	    def restore_state(self, state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
582	        """Replace all in-memory state from a persisted (version-stripped) doc.
583	
584	        Raises :class:`ValueError` when the document is malformed; the current
585	        in-memory state is only replaced after the whole document parses.
586	        """
587	        if not isinstance(state, dict):
588	            raise ValueError("state document must be a JSON object")
589	
590	        raw_devices = state.get("devices", [])
591	        raw_sessions = state.get("sessions", [])
592	        raw_messages = state.get("messages", {})
593	        raw_delivery = state.get("delivery", [])
594	        if not (isinstance(raw_devices, list) and isinstance(raw_sessions, list)
595	                and isinstance(raw_messages, dict)
596	                and isinstance(raw_delivery, list)):
597	            raise ValueError("state document has a malformed top-level section")
598	
599	        devices: Dict[Tuple[str, str], Device] = {}
600	        device_index: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]] = {}
601	        for index, raw in enumerate(raw_devices):
602	            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
603	                raise ValueError(f"devices[{index}] must be an object")
604	            try:
605	                prekeys = []
606	                for pk in raw["prekeys"]:
607	                    if not isinstance(pk, dict):
608	                        raise ValueError("prekey must be an object")
609	                    prekeys.append(SignedPreKey(
610	                        key_id=pk["key_id"], public_key=pk["public_key"],
611	                        revoked=bool(pk.get("revoked", False))))
612	                device = Device(
613	                    user_id=raw["user_id"], device_id=raw["device_id"],
614	                    identity_key=raw["identity_key"],
615	                    registered_at=raw["registered_at"],
616	                    # Older version-1 files predate this field; then it equals
617	                    # registered_at (Device.__post_init__ fills in the default).
618	                    rotated_at=raw.get("rotated_at"),
619	                    prekeys=prekeys, revoked=bool(raw.get("revoked", False)))
620	            except KeyError as error:
621	                raise ValueError(
622	                    f"devices[{index}] missing field: {error.args[0]}") from None
623	            key = (device.user_id, device.device_id)
624	            if key in devices or device.device_id in device_index:
625	                raise ValueError(
626	                    f"duplicate device in state: {device.device_id}")
627	            devices[key] = device
628	            device_index[device.device_id] = key
629	
630	        sessions: Dict[str, Session] = {}
631	        for index, raw in enumerate(raw_sessions):
632	            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
633	                raise ValueError(f"sessions[{index}] must be an object")
634	            try:
635	                session = Session(
636	                    session_id=raw["session_id"],
637	                    initiator_device_id=raw["initiator_device_id"],
638	                    recipient_device_id=raw["recipient_device_id"],
639	                    prekey_id=raw["prekey_id"],
640	                    ephemeral_key=raw["ephemeral_key"],
641	                    identity_key=raw["identity_key"],
642	                    public_key=raw["public_key"],
643	                    created_at=raw["created_at"])
644	            except KeyError as error:
645	                raise ValueError(
646	                    f"sessions[{index}] missing field: {error.args[0]}") from None
647	            if session.session_id in sessions:
648	                raise ValueError(
649	                    f"duplicate session in state: {session.session_id}")
650	            sessions[session.session_id] = session
651	
652	        messages: Dict[str, List[Message]] = {}
653	        for sid, stream in raw_messages.items():
654	            if not isinstance(sid, str) or not isinstance(stream, list):
655	                raise ValueError("messages must map session_id to a list")
656	            parsed: List[Message] = []
657	            for index, raw in enumerate(stream):
658	                if not isinstance(raw, dict):
659	                    raise ValueError(f"messages[{sid}][{index}] must be an object")
660	                try:
661	                    parsed.append(Message(
662	                        session_id=raw["session_id"],
663	                        sender_device_id=raw["sender_device_id"],
664	                        message_id=raw["message_id"],
665	                        sequence=raw["sequence"], nonce=raw["nonce"],
666	                        ciphertext=raw["ciphertext"],
667	                        created_at=raw["created_at"]))
668	                except KeyError as error:
669	                    raise ValueError(
670	                        f"messages[{sid}][{index}] missing field: "
671	                        f"{error.args[0]}") from None
672	            messages[sid] = parsed
673	
674	        delivery: Dict[Tuple[str, str], MessageDelivery] = {}
675	        for index, raw in enumerate(raw_delivery):
676	            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
677	                raise ValueError(f"delivery[{index}] must be an object")
678	            try:
679	                attempt_ids = raw["attempt_ids"]
680	                if not isinstance(attempt_ids, list) or not all(
681	                        isinstance(value, str) for value in attempt_ids):
682	                    raise ValueError("attempt_ids must be a list of strings")
683	                record = MessageDelivery(
684	                    attempts=int(raw["attempts"]),
685	                    attempt_ids=set(attempt_ids),
686	                    acked=bool(raw["acked"]),
687	                    ack_sequence=int(raw["ack_sequence"]))
688	                dkey = (raw["session_id"], raw["message_id"])
689	            except KeyError as error:
690	                raise ValueError(
691	                    f"delivery[{index}] missing field: {error.args[0]}") from None
692	            if dkey in delivery:
693	                raise ValueError(
694	                    f"duplicate delivery record in state: {dkey}")
695	            delivery[dkey] = record
696	
697	        with self._lock:
698	            self._devices = devices
699	            self._device_index = device_index
700	            self._sessions = sessions
701	            self._messages = messages
702	            self._delivery = delivery
